name: slider
title: Slider
description: A continuous or stepped value (or a range) in one control frame: the Meter's rail with an ink fill, a 2px thumb with a grip keyline, and a readout cell sized for the longest value.

.kl-slider-fill.transition:
width calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out),
      inset-inline-start calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out)

.kl-slider-thumb.transition:
inset-inline-start calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out),
      bottom calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out)
